name: CI

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      - feat/**

env:
  FORCE_JAVASCRIPT_ACTIONS_TO_NODE24: "true"

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  native-codex:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - version: "0.153.0"
            sha256: "35a82c153d83959de09c2cb84ac70ba69d05788aeeb08d4a95ca68e39f86680e"
          - version: "0.155.0"
            sha256: "e415cc3adb94ade16e8d44b4dd58a9201cc34b2ee51a5d6eddf2a3a00aecb6c0"
          - version: "0.156.1"
            sha256: "aff46539a83aff86e3c62c592bce2c50d95391f9df289afaf03a50c01d14533d"
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: 24
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@ea17c68df8912ef543352723c149a84f56e3d413 # v6.1.0
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: Fetch pinned official native engines
        env:
          CODEX_VERSION: ${{ matrix.version }}
          CODEX_SHA256: ${{ matrix.sha256 }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          install_codex() {
            local version="$1" digest="$2" directory="$RUNNER_TEMP/codex-$1"
            mkdir -p "$directory"
            curl --fail --location --retry 2 --output "$directory/codex.tar.gz" \
              "https://github.com/openai/codex/releases/download/rust-v$version/codex-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz"
            printf '%s  %s\n' "$digest" "$directory/codex.tar.gz" | sha256sum --check --status
            tar -xzf "$directory/codex.tar.gz" -C "$directory"
            test "$("$directory/codex-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl" --version)" = "codex-cli $version"
          }
          install_codex "$CODEX_VERSION" "$CODEX_SHA256"
          # The 0.153 engine accepts Astra metadata but its own bundle predates it.
          producer_version="$CODEX_VERSION"
          if [ "$CODEX_VERSION" = 0.153.0 ]; then
            install_codex 0.155.0 e415cc3adb94ade16e8d44b4dd58a9201cc34b2ee51a5d6eddf2a3a00aecb6c0
            producer_version=0.155.0
          fi
          echo "CLAWROUTER_CODEX_BINARY=$RUNNER_TEMP/codex-$CODEX_VERSION/codex-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "CLAWROUTER_CODEX_CATALOG_BINARY=$RUNNER_TEMP/codex-$producer_version/codex-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          if [ "$CODEX_VERSION" = 0.155.0 ]; then
            echo "CLAWROUTER_DESKTOP_FIXTURE_OUTPUT=$RUNNER_TEMP/codex-desktop-fixture" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          fi
      - name: Native client through real router and ledgers
        run: node --test test/codex-router.test.mjs test/codex-native.test.mjs test/codex-connect.test.mjs
      - name: Upload synthetic Desktop configuration
        if: matrix.version == '0.155.0'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: codex-desktop-fixture-${{ github.sha }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/codex-desktop-fixture
          include-hidden-files: true
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 1

  self-host:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - name: Build and smoke self-host image
        run: |
          read -r admin_token < <(openssl rand -hex 32)
          admin_hash="$(printf '%s' "$admin_token" | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}')"
          docker build -f deploy/self-host/Dockerfile -t clawrouter-self-host:ci .
          container_id="$(docker run -d -p 8787:8787 \
            -e CLAWROUTER_ADMIN_TOKEN_SHA256="$admin_hash" \
            clawrouter-self-host:ci)"
          trap 'docker logs "$container_id"; docker rm -fv "$container_id" >/dev/null' EXIT
          node -p 'JSON.stringify({ node: process.version, undici: process.versions.undici, platform: process.platform, arch: process.arch })'
          CLAWROUTER_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8787 \
            CLAWROUTER_ADMIN_TOKEN="[REDACTED]" \
            node scripts/smoke-self-host.mjs

  admin:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: 24
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@ea17c68df8912ef543352723c149a84f56e3d413 # v6.1.0
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: pnpm --dir admin test
      - run: pnpm --dir admin build
      - run: pnpm --dir admin exec playwright install --with-deps chromium
      - run: pnpm --dir admin exec playwright test
        id: browser
      - name: Upload browser failure output
        if: failure() && steps.browser.outcome == 'failure'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: admin-browser-failure-${{ github.sha }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: |
            admin/test-results
            admin/playwright-report
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 3

  admin-fusion-macos:
    runs-on: xcode-27
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: 24
          architecture: arm64
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@ea17c68df8912ef543352723c149a84f56e3d413 # v6.1.0
      - name: Verify macOS runtime
        run: |
          node -e 'if (process.platform !== "darwin" || process.arch !== "arm64") throw new Error("Expected Darwin ARM64"); console.log(JSON.stringify({ node: process.version, platform: process.platform, arch: process.arch }))'
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: pnpm --dir admin build
      - run: pnpm --dir admin exec playwright install chromium
      - name: Check Fusion mobile screenshot and accessibility
        id: browser
        run: >-
          pnpm --dir admin exec playwright test dashboard.spec.ts
          --project mobile --workers 1 --retries 0
          --grep 'Fusion preflight is WCAG AA clean and visually stable$'
      - name: Upload Fusion screenshot differences
        if: failure() && steps.browser.outcome == 'failure' && hashFiles('admin/test-results/**/fusion-readiness-actual.png') != ''
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: admin-fusion-macos-failure-${{ github.sha }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: |
            admin/test-results/**/fusion-readiness-actual.png
            admin/test-results/**/fusion-readiness-expected.png
            admin/test-results/**/fusion-readiness-diff.png
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 3

  worker-package:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: 24
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@ea17c68df8912ef543352723c149a84f56e3d413 # v6.1.0
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: Compile provider snapshot
        run: |
          pnpm provider:compile -- --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/provider-snapshot.json"
          git rev-parse HEAD
          sha256sum "$RUNNER_TEMP/provider-snapshot.json"
      - name: Upload provider snapshot
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: provider-snapshot-${{ github.sha }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/provider-snapshot.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 3
      - run: pnpm worker:check
      - run: pnpm worker:e2e
      - run: pnpm test:scripts
      - run: pnpm provider:smoke-plan
      - run: CLAWROUTER_STRICT_CONFIG=0 pnpm cf:config
      - run: timeout 900s pnpm exec wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir /tmp/clawrouter-worker-dry-run --config .wrangler.generated.toml
        timeout-minutes: 16
        env:
          WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS: "false"

services:
  clawrouter:
    image: clawrouter-self-host:latest
    build:
      context: ../..
      dockerfile: deploy/self-host/Dockerfile
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:8787:8787"
    volumes:
      - clawrouter-data:/data
    env_file:
      - .env
    restart: unless-stopped

volumes:
  clawrouter-data:

# Browser proof and snapshots

Build before running the suite: `pnpm --dir admin build`, then
`pnpm --dir admin exec playwright test`. The configuration serves `admin/dist`
through Vite preview and records desktop/mobile Chromium snapshots with a
platform suffix. Accessibility checks run alongside the visual assertions.

The `admin` CI job uses Ubuntu x86_64 and the Playwright version pinned in
`admin/package.json`. Generate Linux baselines on Linux x86_64, for example
with `mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.63.0-noble` and Docker's
`--platform linux/amd64 --ipc=host`. Copy the source into a scratch directory,
excluding `.git`, `node_modules`, `admin/dist`, and previous test results, and
mount that directory as `/repo`. Inside the container, run:

```sh
npm install -g pnpm@11.28.4
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm --dir admin build
pnpm --dir admin exec playwright test dashboard.spec.ts --grep 'dashboard is WCAG AA clean and visually stable$' --update-snapshots
pnpm --dir admin exec playwright test
```

Inspect the changed images before copying only the intended `*-linux.png`
files back from `admin/browser/__screenshots__`. Keep the exact visual
threshold and WCAG assertions. Never rename macOS output to a Linux filename.
For Darwin baselines, use the same build and update commands on macOS and
copy only the corresponding `*-darwin.png` files. The separate macOS CI job
checks the mobile Fusion snapshot.

# ClawRouter self-hosting

Docker Compose quickstart, administration, persistence, and limitations:
[Self-hosting ClawRouter](../../docs/self-hosting.md).

# Console redesign — "Patchboard"

Visual system for the ClawRouter browser console (July 2026). Screenshots in
this directory are matching-viewport demo captures used for visual review.

## System

- **Identity**: patch-panel instrument console. Copper signal accent
  (`#bc3c08` light / `#ff7847` dark) on blueprint-paper porcelain (light) and
  graphite ink (dark). Semantic colors stay independent: moss = healthy,
  ochre = attention, oxide = blocked.
- **Type**: [Archivo Variable](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Archivo)
  carries UI text and uses its width axis for display headlines;
  [Spline Sans Mono](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Spline+Sans+Mono)
  carries every numeral, code path, table header, and stencil label. Both are
  bundled through Fontsource — no runtime font requests, no unloaded
  font-family references.
- **Geometry**: sharp 1px hairline panels, 4px control radius, rectangular
  stencil status tags, 3px accent rails for selection (nav, table rows,
  callouts, attention metrics).
- **Structure**: stylesheets are semantic modules under `admin/src/styles/`
  (`tokens`, `base`, `shell`, `tables`, `workspace`, `dashboard`,
  `playground`, `usage`) replacing the append-only numbered files
  (`01.css`–`07.css`) whose later layers overrode earlier ones.

## Files

- `before-*.png` — previous design, light theme.
- `after-*.png` — Patchboard, light theme.
- `after-dark-*.png` — Patchboard, dark theme.
- `analytics-before-*.png` / `analytics-after-*.png` — Dashboard and Usage
  before/after evidence for the data-first analytics layout.
